description: Execute an action that is already approved (by the founder, the team or autopilot) ahead of its scheduled slot, through the same path as the web app: leases, spend ceilings and platform policy apply, and it publishes through the owner's connected accounts. Refuses a draft that has not been approved. Approver or higher.

retry.description: Also run an action that already completed or failed, as a fresh attempt. Default false.

name: run
title: Run an approved action now
